title: Google Chronicle

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: The customer ID identifying the Google Chronicle tenant to stream into.

fields.name: google_service_credentials
fields.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud credentials JSON file.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record is sent to Google Chronicle. If you specify a key name with this option, only the value of that key is sent.

fields.name: log_type
fields.description: The log type to parse logs as. Google Chronicle supports parsing for specific log types only.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: The project ID containing the Google Chronicle tenant to stream into.
fields.default: Value of the project_id in the credentials file

fields.name: region
fields.description: The GCP region in which to store security logs. Supported regions: US, EU, UK, ASIA. Blank is treated as US.

fields.name: service_account_email
fields.description: Account email associated with the service. Only available if no credentials file has been provided.

fields.name: service_account_secret
fields.description: Private key content associated with the service account. Only available if no credentials file has been provided.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Google Chronicle.
